Ryan: Friday LAN + VR demo at 7pm in 4th floor lounge! thinking of doing a mix of PC LAN (Valheim/Vermintide) and some Quest demos. Who can bring monitors/power strips/ethernet? Also doing a small Steam wishlist gift swap — drop links if you want in.

Maria: I can bring a 27" monitor + HDMI cable. I also have a 5-port switch if needed. :woman-raising-hand: 

Jamal: I’ll bring a surge strip and two spare ethernet cables. Can someone confirm if the wall ports on the east side are free? @infra-bot ?

infra-bot: Ryan booked 4th-floor lounge for 2026-03-27 19:00–23:00. Please keep noise to a reasonable level after 10pm. Network: east-wall ports 1-4 are available. :white_check_mark:

Sophia: Steam wishlist: https://steamcommunity.com/id/sophia/wishlist (feel free to add me). Also down for Mario Kart on Switch if folks bring a dock + controllers.

Aaron: Happy to host a dedicated Valheim server for the night. Server details:
```
IP: 10.13.37.22
Password: redwood-lan
Start script: ./start_valheim.sh --world LAN-Night
```
I’ll bring a laptop to run it.

Katie: I have a portable 1Gbps switch + spare monitor stand. PS: I can lend two joy-cons and a USB-C dock for Switch.

Ryan: Amazing — thanks! Quick poll: who needs a monitor? react with :monitor: if yes. And who wants VR demo? react with :vr:
